sourceText:
Polish Doughnuts
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:55am

Ingredients




1 pkg. yeast
1/4 cup lukewarm water
1 3/4 cups milk, scalded
left to cool
4 egg yolks
1 whole egg
1/2 cup sugar
1/4 pound butter, melted
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 teaspoon salt
7 cups flour
1 teaspoon lemon or orange rind (opt.)

Preparation

1 Dissolve yeast in water. Add milk and 2 cups flour to dissolved yeast. Beat well, set aside to rise for 30 minutes. (This is called a "sponge".) 2 Beat eggs, sugar, vanilla, rind and salt until light and lemon colored. Add to sponge. Add melted butter and the remaining 5 cups of flour. Cover and let rise 1 hour. 3 Roll out on floured board 1/2 inch thick. Cut with doughnut cutter. Let rise. Deep fry in shortening until each side is brown.
